talents.heroTreeEvidence: buff 'arcane_soul' (spell 451038, the Sunfury capstone buff) has nonzero start_count (~3.67/fight) and real uptime in collected_data; APL only calls the 'sunfury' action list when !talent.splintering_sorcery, and splintering_sorcery is a Spellslinger-only hero node -- so its absence (and arcane_soul's presence) together confirm Sunfury was picked over Spellslinger.
talents.apexTalent: Prismatic Bolt (spellId 1295923 talent node / 1295924 damage spell) -- reqPoints 20, tiered node with 4 ranks, all ranks implied selected since APL and action_sequence show all three Prismatic Bolt rank effects active (bonus Clearcasting chance, Arcane Missiles/Barrage damage amp) and it fires as the 2nd highest damage source in the sample.
confirmedTalentsFromLiveData: Spellfire Spheres (buff 'spellfire_sphere', spell 448604, real stack data in rotation trace)
Energized Familiar (spell 452997, nonzero mana-gain events under 'Energized Familiar' in gains)
Orb Mastery -- referenced by APL condition talent.orb_mastery gating arcane_orb priority; Arcane Orb is cast in the sample rotation (low dmg share, consistent with charge-generator role)
talents.uncertainNote: Point-by-point allocation for the remaining ~15 spec-tree choice/single nodes could not be reverse-engineered from the JSON report alone -- the report only exposes the opaque Blizzard loadout export string (above), not a resolved node list. Decoding that string requires Blizzard's bit-packed talent-loadout format, which needs a JS/Python runtime to run safely (none available in this environment) -- flagged as a gap rather than guessed.
